business_process: Supervision and jail program case management for AG-02 and AG-39 (CJI)
description: Pretrial, probation, and jail program officers record check-ins, conditions, court dates, and violations; criminal history summaries are imported from the message switches
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract RTO 8 h and RPO 1 h; officers need conditions and warrant status for court and field contacts; each sheriff can run one shift on printed rosters
manual_workaround: Sheriffs print next-day court and check-in rosters nightly; officers call the records unit for criminal history
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; sheriffs' identity providers and message switches
dependent_people_or_facilities: Cloud operations on-call; support; AG-02 local agency security officer; AG-39 terminal agency coordinator
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,100 officers and program staff; a 12-hour outage puts 2 shifts on printed rosters
quantified_regulatory_impact: Breach of the CJI service terms; court reporting deadlines missed by the sheriffs
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 CP-2, CP-10); Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate)

business_process: Benefits application intake and verification for AG-03
description: Caseworkers log applications, request and review verification documents, and route tasks for SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid statewide
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract RTO 8 h; SNAP expedited service requires benefits by the 7th calendar day after filing (7 CFR 273.2(i)(3)) and normal processing within 30 days (273.2(g)(1)); a day down compresses those clocks for thousands of households
manual_workaround: Paper intake log; caseworkers work directly in the agency eligibility system
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; AG-03 identity provider and eligibility system
dependent_people_or_facilities: Cloud operations; support; AG-03 information security manager
quantified_operational_impact: About 2,500 new applications and 9,000 verification tasks a day across 6 regions, worked by about 3,000 caseworkers
quantified_regulatory_impact: SNAP processing clocks at risk for expedited households; service credits

business_process: Tax compliance casework for AG-01 (FTI enclave)
description: Auditors and collectors manage cases, notices, and taxpayer correspondence
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract RTO 8 h and RPO 1 h; statutory notice dates can be met by the agency tax system for 2 days; AG-01 is about $9.5 million a year and renews in 2027
manual_workaround: Agency works collections from its tax system; outbound notices held
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; AG-01 identity provider and file transfer
dependent_people_or_facilities: FTI enclave administrator group (6); support; AG-01 disclosure officer
quantified_operational_impact: About 600 agency auditors and collectors; about 4,000 case actions a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: IRS Office of Safeguards review exposure if FTI integrity is in doubt; service credits
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 CP-2, CP-9); Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate)

business_process: Motor vehicle title and registration casework for AG-04
description: Clerks resolve title problems, registration holds, and dealer complaints using motor vehicle record data
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract RTO 8 h; walk-in offices can process routine transactions in the state system but not held cases
manual_workaround: Clerks defer held cases and use the state motor vehicle system directly for routine work
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; state motor vehicle data feed
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,200 held cases a day across 9 tax collector offices
quantified_regulatory_impact: Service credits; no DPPA issue from an outage alone

business_process: Municipal constituent services, code enforcement, and permitting (AG-05 to AG-38, AG-40 to AG-43)
description: Constituent requests, complaints, inspections, and local business tax cases for 38 cities and counties
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contracts allow 24 h recovery; work can queue on paper for 3 days
manual_workaround: Paper forms and phone intake; agencies post a service notice
quantified_operational_impact: About 6,000 constituent cases opened a day across 38 customers

description: Nightly AG-01 file transfers, AG-02 and AG-39 message-switch imports, the AG-03 eligibility API, and the AG-04 motor vehicle feed
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Interfaces feed BP-01 to BP-04; files and messages can be replayed from agency systems for about 3 days
manual_workaround: Agencies resend files; manual lookups by agency staff
dependent_third_parties: Agency interface endpoints; message switch operators
quantified_operational_impact: About 1.4 million interface messages and 40 file transfers a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: CJI and FTI transmission terms (FIPS-validated encryption) must hold after recovery
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 3.3.1); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SC-8, SC-13)

description: Document extraction and suggested outcomes for about 310 caseworkers in 3 regions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Caseworkers can do the whole job without it; an outage only removes the assistant
manual_workaround: Caseworkers review documents manually (the normal process in the other 3 regions)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Data and AI; data and AI team
quantified_operational_impact: Caseworker handling time rises about 20% in the 3 regions
quantified_regulatory_impact: None from an outage; see P10 for the decision risks

business_process: Customer support and agency incident communications
description: 24x7 service desk, status page, and security notices to agency contacts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Agency clocks start before any system is back: 1 hour for suspected CJI incidents (CJISSECPOL IR-6), the agency's 24-hour IRS reporting (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8), 12-hour Florida ransomware reports by agencies (Fla. Stat. 282.318, 282.3185)
manual_workaround: Printed agency contact list in the incident binder; phone tree; status updates by phone
dependent_people_or_facilities: 45 support staff; Director of Contracts and Compliance
quantified_operational_impact: About 900 tickets a day; 44 agency security contacts
quantified_regulatory_impact: Late agency notice can put the agency in breach of its own reporting duty
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8.4); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a)

description: Engineers administer about 410 agency servers at 9 agencies (AG-02 RMS and jail management, AG-08 to AG-14 permitting and finance) through SYS-10
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Managed services contracts require a response within 4 hours for severity 1 issues; the agency systems keep running without the company, but cannot be fixed or recovered
manual_workaround: Agency IT staff work on site with company engineers by phone; on-site visits to AG-02
dependent_third_parties: Remote management platform vendor; agency networks
dependent_people_or_facilities: 55 managed services engineers; agency IT staff
quantified_operational_impact: Severity 1 response for 9 agencies; AG-02 jail management supports about 2,400 inmates
quantified_regulatory_impact: CJIS Security Addendum duties continue for AG-02 systems during the outage

business_process: Monitoring and patching of agency-hosted systems
description: Health monitoring, backups checks, and monthly patching of agency servers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patching can slip a few days, but CJIS SI-2 sets 15 days for critical updates on AG-02 systems
manual_workaround: Agency IT staff patch critical items locally
quantified_operational_impact: About 410 servers; about 1,600 patches a month
quantified_regulatory_impact: CJISSECPOL v6.1 SI-2 remediation days for AG-02 systems

business_process: Implementation, configuration, and data migration projects
description: About 25 active projects for new and expanding agency customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $120,000 of billable services a day; consultants can keep working at agency sites but cannot reach company environments, so about 60% of billable work stops
manual_workaround: Consultants work on agency premises; replan milestones
quantified_operational_impact: About 25 projects; about 60% of billable hours stop

description: Classroom and online training for agency users
Build, test, and deploy fixes and security patches through the pipeline
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Needed to patch a critical vulnerability; CJIS SI-2 sets 15 days for critical updates on CJI systems; releases can pause 3 days
manual_workaround: Hold releases; emergency change procedure with second approver
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SI-2); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 SI-2)

description: Scheduled reports and dashboards from SYS-08 for agency managers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reports can be rerun after recovery

business_process: Payroll, HR, and personnel security screening
description: Biweekly payroll, onboarding, terminations, fingerprint-based checks and background investigations through agencies
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; screening gates for CJI and FTI access must keep working for new starts
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; hold new starts that need CJI or FTI access
quantified_operational_impact: 600 employees paid biweekly; about 12 new starts a month
quantified_regulatory_impact: CJIS PS-3 and Pub. 1075 screening before access

description: Agency invoicing, collections, payables, and bank operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices can wait a week; about $2 million of invoicing a week
manual_workaround: Manual invoices from the contract register
quantified_operational_impact: About $2 million of invoices a week delayed (cash, not loss)

business_process: Contract management, proposals, and compliance reporting
description: Bid responses, contract security attestations, and agency compliance reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bid deadlines are fixed; missing one can lose a multi-year contract
manual_workaround: Prepare bids from offline copies; ask agencies for extensions
quantified_operational_impact: About 6 bids and 20 compliance reports a month
quantified_regulatory_impact: Contract attestations and GovRAMP evidence deadlines

description: MDR monitoring, triage, and incident command for the ACMC and corporate systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Detection and agency notice clocks depend on it: 1-hour CJI reporting, 24-hour FTI reporting by AG-01
manual_workaround: MDR provider runs from its own platform; manual log review from the archive account
dependent_people_or_facilities: Security Operations Manager and 3 security engineers; MDR analysts
quantified_operational_impact: About 1.2 billion log events a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Without monitoring, incidents cannot be scoped and notices widen
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-4, IR-6); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8)
